title: What to buy
sub: The display board, the battery and everything else besides the printed parts, with where to get it in India. The parts list is in documentation/assembly.md; prices here are estimates.

groups.label: Electronics
groups.note: The housing is modelled around this exact board: buy the same one.

items.name: ESP32-2424S012 1.28" round display board (ESP32-C3)
items.for: The display and its processor (sold as "Electrobot ESP32-C3 1.28in"; the model is on its silkscreen)
items.note: Check the listing photo shows "ESP32-2424S012" on the board.

items.name: LiPo cell with protection PCB, 402030 (about 200–250 mAh), JST 1.25 mm 2-pin plug
items.for: The battery, in the cover's bay (1 mm room to swell)
items.note: Check the plug's polarity against the board before connecting: clones often have it reversed.

items.name: USB-C cable
items.for: Power and charging, through the TPU plug

items.name: Clear polycarbonate, 1 mm (a 36.2 mm disc: lens.dxf)
items.local: a plastic-sheet dealer (or a laser-cutting shop)

items.name: Thin closed-cell foam tape, 0.5 mm
items.for: The foam ring behind the lens (display_gasket.dxf)

items.name: EVA or PORON foam, 1.5 mm
items.for: The pad on the board retainer

items.name: 1 mm silicone or EPDM sheet (or print the gasket in TPU)
Clear RTV silicone (or a VHB ring)
Rubber shim, about 1 mm, 22 x 75 mm
items.for: Wraps the bar inside the clamp
items.where: An old bicycle inner tube works.

groups.label: Screws and the bayonet's ball plunger

items.name: M2 x 3 heat-set inserts (3.2 mm hole)
M2 x 8 socket cap screws, stainless
items.search: M2 x 8 socket cap screw stainless

items.name: M4 stainless spring-ball plunger (ball 2.5 mm, stroke at least 0.8 mm)
M3 x 6–8 thread-forming screws for plastic, pan head
items.search: M3 self tapping screw for plastic

items.name: M5 x 25 socket cap screws + M5 nyloc nuts
Printing: housing, cover, retainer, receiver, clamp (ASA, or PETG for a prototype) + the USB plug in TPU 95A
items.for: Upload the STLs for an exact quote
